process.title: Less guesswork. More peace of mind.
process.text: You provide the information. We help organize the tax picture and explain what comes next.

steps.text: Meet with us in office or ask our team about remote filing. We review your situation and confirm the scope and fee.

checklist.title: A little preparation. A smoother tax return.
checklist.text: Use this checklist as a starting point. Select a category to see additional records that may be relevant.
checklist.note: Your accountant may request more information after reviewing your circumstances.
checklist.privacy: Checkmarks are for your preparation only. No documents or personal information are sent from this page.

tabs.label: Personal
items: Government-issued photo ID and personal details
All income slips, including employment, pension and investment slips
Last return and Notice of Assessment, if available
RRSP/FHSA contribution receipts and relevant tax slips
Medical, childcare and charitable donation receipts
Tuition slips and other records relevant to your year

tabs.label: Self-employed
items: Personal tax documents from the Personal checklist
Business income records and invoices
Business expense receipts and bank statements
Vehicle expenses and business-use mileage log, if applicable
Home workspace expenses and usage details, if applicable
Equipment purchases and prior-year business schedules

tabs.label: Rental income
items: Personal tax documents from the Personal checklist
Rental income records for each property
Expense receipts, property tax and insurance statements
Mortgage interest statements
Property purchase or sale documents, if applicable
Prior-year rental schedules and ownership details

tabs.label: Newcomer
items: Government-issued ID and personal details
Date of arrival and information about residency ties
Canadian income slips and supporting records
Foreign income records and relevant tax documents
Spouse and dependant information, if applicable
Prior correspondence from the CRA, if available

options.title: In-office tax preparation
options.text: Bring your records, speak with an accountant and work through your questions together.

options.title: Remote tax preparation
options.text: Ask our team how to provide your records securely, review your return and complete the filing authorization remotely.

options.title: A more complex situation?
options.text: Tell us if you also need corporate, estate and trust, or US/Canada cross-border tax support so we can arrange the right service.

items.question: How much will my tax return cost?
items.answer: The fee depends on the complexity of your return, income sources and additional filings. Contact us with a brief outline of your situation so we can confirm the scope and fee before starting.

items.question: Can you help if I have several years to file?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us which years are outstanding and share any CRA correspondence. We will identify the records needed for each year and discuss a plan to bring your filings up to date.

items.question: What if I am missing a tax slip?
items.answer: Let us know which document is missing. We can discuss ways to obtain it and identify other records that may be needed. CRA account access requires the appropriate authorization.

items.question: Can you prepare my family's returns together?
items.answer: Yes. Let us know who needs a return and whether your marital status or dependants changed. Each person's information and required authorizations will be reviewed separately.

items.question: Can I file without visiting your office?
items.answer: Contact our team to arrange remote tax preparation and receive secure document-sharing instructions. Please avoid sending your SIN, tax slips or other sensitive records in ordinary email.

items.question: Will you explain my refund or balance owing?
items.answer: We review the prepared return with you and explain the result before filing. The CRA's assessment may differ if it changes or requests clarification of information in the return.
